newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL -- Tele-Communications trading late.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL -- Tele-Communications trading late.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc was among the few issues trading after hours Friday as investors pondered the significance of Chairman John Malone's decision to bring in an outsider as president, traders said.
Tele-Communications was trading at 13-7/8, near where it closed in regular trading. For the day the stock was down 1/8.
Otherwise few issues were moving in after-hours trading, as the market's frenzied late-afternoon rally seemed to have depleted traders' energy.
"Nothing really exciting is happening," one after-hour specialist said.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 11,400, compared to Thursday's 34,400. Session two volume was 2,283,400, while Thursday's volume was 239,229.
